name: Confluent Kafka Source
shortDescription: Consume data from a Kafka topic in Confluent Cloud and publish it to a topic in Quix

Variables.Name: output
Variables.Description: This is the Quix Topic that will receive the stream

Variables.Name: CONFLUENT_KAFKA_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: Confluent Cloud broker address and API credentials from a shared Variable Group.
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared Confluent Cloud bootstrap server and API key/secret.

Variables.Description: Bootstrap server address, obtained from the Confluent Kafka portal
API key, obtained from the Confluent Kafka portal
API secret, obtained from the Confluent Kafka portal
SASL mechanism for authentication. One of: PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512, GSSAPI, OAUTHBEARER, AWS_MSK_IAM. Confluent Cloud API keys use PLAIN
Path to the SSL CA certificate file. Leave empty to use the system's default CA certificates

Variables.Name: kafka_topic
Variables.Description: The Confluent Kafka Topic you wish to read from
